title: 03 / Graph generation process
subtitle: A source becomes a draft graph; an explicit publication makes it available for answers.

nodes.title: 1. Bring sources in
nodes.detail:
Upload, folder, link, GitHub,
SharePoint, Jira, ServiceNow

nodes.title: 2. Private original
nodes.detail:
Record size and SHA-256
S3 or configured file store

nodes.title: 3. Security scan
nodes.detail:
ClamAV; refuse infected
or unverifiable input

nodes.title: Rejected / failed
nodes.detail:
Record the reason
Never convert unsafe input

nodes.title: 4. Convert + OCR
nodes.detail:
Isolated offline conversion
Markdown text + digest

nodes.title: 5. Knowledge record
nodes.detail:
Immutable source revision
chunks + source identity

nodes.title: 6. Advisory checks
nodes.detail:
PII/PHI, readability, type
and source relationships

nodes.title: 7. Structural graph
nodes.detail:
Automatic, no model call
Reuse verified unchanged AI

nodes.title: 8. AI requested?
nodes.detail:
Explicit run or owner refresh
Permissions + monthly budget

nodes.title: 9. AI enrichment
nodes.detail:
Extract entities / relations
Verify exact source quotes

nodes.title: 10. Embeddings
nodes.detail:
Optional; configured provider
Budgeted and receipted

nodes.title: 11. Draft version
nodes.detail:
GraphRevision snapshot
GraphElement version ranges

nodes.title: 12. Measure + review
nodes.detail:
Benchmark + graph health
Reviewer inspects quality

nodes.title: 13. Publish?
nodes.detail:
An authorized person
selects the version

nodes.title: Published graph
nodes.detail:
Available to graph answers
and workflow evidence

nodes.title: Keep draft
nodes.detail:
Review or rebuild later
Never answers questions

title: 04 / Graph retrieval process
subtitle: Rank candidate relationships, then prove every citation from its live source.

nodes.title: Question / caller
nodes.detail:
Chat, API, MCP, Code Factory
Code review or ServiceOps

nodes.title: Application access
nodes.detail:
Grant + feature checks
Scope fixed before retrieval

nodes.title: Published version
nodes.detail:
Latest or conversation-pinned
Drafts refused

nodes.title: No evidence / refusal
nodes.detail:
No grant, no published graph
or no valid citations

nodes.title: Read the question
nodes.detail:
Follow-up context, terms
Keep BR-05-like IDs whole

nodes.title: Rank by words
nodes.detail:
Coverage then BM25
Rows or JSON snapshot

nodes.title: Fuse by meaning
nodes.detail:
Optional query embedding
Owner-enabled paid help

nodes.title: Walk relationships
nodes.detail:
Typed two-hop paths
Plus one-hop neighbours

nodes.title: Verify live evidence
nodes.detail:
Allowed + active + same digest
Exact quote still present

nodes.title: Diverse evidence
nodes.detail:
Spread across sources
Keep at most 8 citations

nodes.title: Optional reranking
nodes.detail:
Model reorders IDs only
Cannot invent evidence

nodes.title: Caller decides output
nodes.detail: Evidence API or answer flow

nodes.title: API / MCP evidence
nodes.detail:
JSON citations + graph version
No model spend

nodes.title: Compose answer
nodes.detail:
Chat model uses verified pack
Scoped tools may find more

nodes.title: Verify again + save
nodes.detail:
Keep only live valid citations
Persist and render escaped

title: 07 / Code Factory process
subtitle: Evidence-backed planning and controlled implementation with separate delivery authorization.

nodes.title: Ticket / manual request
nodes.detail:
Authorize feature and user
Copy ticket + digest

nodes.title: Pin evidence + code
nodes.detail:
Published graph version
Code snapshot + repository

nodes.title: 1. Triage
nodes.detail:
Classify request
Extract stated requirements

nodes.title: 2. Analysis
nodes.detail:
Stated / functional / NFR gaps
Cite verified evidence

nodes.title: 3. Design
nodes.detail:
Targets + change summaries
Create ChangePlan

nodes.title: Plan approval
nodes.detail:
Authorized approver reviews
Reject or approve digest

nodes.title: 4. Work order
nodes.detail:
Approved scope
Implementation instructions

nodes.title: 5. Implementation
nodes.detail:
Prepare candidate contents
No delivery credential needed

nodes.title: 6. Test author
nodes.detail:
Produce relevant tests
Against approved changes

nodes.title: 7. Change review
nodes.detail:
Review scope, safety
and evidence

nodes.title: 8. Verification
nodes.detail:
Check prepared change
Record phase result

nodes.title: Delivery gate
nodes.detail:
Confirm repo + base branch
Separate write credential

nodes.title: 9. Delivery
nodes.detail:
GitHub branch + pull request
Or permitted local demo delivery

nodes.title: Checks + refresh
nodes.detail:
Read repository CI outcomes
Refresh code knowledge

nodes.title: Run history
nodes.detail:
Phase status, costs, events
Evidence and output digests

nodes.title: Rejected / failed / stalled
nodes.detail:
No next phase on failure
Review reason before retry

nodes.title: Prepare ≠ deliver
nodes.detail: Preparation can finish without GitHub write access. Publishing re-checks grants, plan, repository and credentials.

title: 08 / ServiceOps process
subtitle: Read-only incident triage and separately gated real automation.

nodes.title: Incident intake
nodes.detail:
ServiceNow / Jira import
Or manual incident

nodes.title: 1. Profile symptoms
nodes.detail:
Service, CI, priority, terms
Digest + fingerprint

nodes.title: 2. Gather evidence
nodes.detail:
Ops graph + precedents
Changes + published runbooks

nodes.title: 3. Optional AI triage
nodes.detail:
At most three hypotheses
Read-only checks only

nodes.title: 4. Verify citations
nodes.detail:
Exact quotes; source usable
Digest and app scope

nodes.title: 5. Rate evidence
nodes.detail:
Support + counter-evidence
Report limits and uncertainty

nodes.title: 6. Save brief
nodes.detail:
TriageRun + hypotheses
Evidence-only fallback

nodes.title: Responder verdict
nodes.detail:
Accept / reject / partial
Record confirmed cause

nodes.title: Owner requests runbook
nodes.detail:
Discover allowed catalog
Idempotent request key

nodes.title: Execution approval
nodes.detail:
Different owner if required
Recheck grants + source digest

nodes.title: Worker launch
nodes.detail:
One active execution per app
Registered local or AWX adapter

nodes.title: Monitor + verify
nodes.detail:
Local postconditions
AWX job status + bounded poll

nodes.title: Execution receipt
nodes.detail:
Status, timing, effects
No secret-bearing stdout

nodes.title: Needs reconciliation
nodes.detail:
Ambiguous external launch
Never blindly retry POST

nodes.title: Validate submission

nodes.title: Persist before provider

nodes.title: Start answer worker

Own DB connection

nodes.title: Conversation mode

Fixed for conversation

nodes.title: Graph answer

nodes.title: AI answer / excerpts

nodes.title: Model + scoped tools

nodes.title: Emit answer events

nodes.title: Browser SSE reader

complete / stopped / failed
